titleZh: 敏銳 ↔ 愚鈍｜手術刀對橡皮槌
hook: acumen／adroit 是手術刀，asinine／crass／obtuse 是橡皮槌——同一題，切開或敲平。
script: 敏銳隊：acumen／acuity／adroit／astute／perspicacious。愚鈍隊：asinine／crass／obtuse／dense。口令：刀寫洞察，槌寫「我聽不懂但很大聲」。

members.speakLineEn: Her business acumen helped the startup survive its first tough year.
members.speakLineZh: 她的商業敏銳與洞察力幫助新創熬過艱難的第一年。

members.speakLineEn: Mental acuity matters when you must spot errors in dense legal text.
members.speakLineZh: 要在密實法律文本中抓錯，心思敏銳至關重要。

members.speakLineEn: His adroit replies to hecklers won him supporters in the crowded hall.
members.speakLineZh: 他對搗亂者敏捷靈巧的回覆，在擁擠大廳贏得支持者。

members.speakLineEn: An astute tenant always reads the small print before signing a lease.
members.speakLineZh: 精明的房客簽約前一定會讀細則小字。

members.speakLineEn: She made a shrewd trade that protected the firm from a sudden loss.
members.speakLineZh: 她做了一筆精明交易，讓公司免於突然虧損。

related.synonyms: astute, sharp, calculating, calculative, conniving, scheming

members.speakLineEn: Skipping the safety drill was an asinine choice that risked everyone.
members.speakLineZh: 跳過安全演練是愚蠢的選擇，讓所有人陷入風險。

members.speakLineEn: His crass joke about the accident silenced the entire dinner table.
members.speakLineZh: 他對意外開的粗俗愚鈍玩笑，讓整桌晚餐陷入沉默。

members.speakLineEn: He seemed deliberately obtuse when asked who had changed the numbers.
members.speakLineZh: 被問到是誰改了數字時，他顯得刻意愚鈍。

members.speakLineEn: The professor's dense explanation left half the class still confused.
members.speakLineZh: 教授難以理解的說明，讓半數同學仍然困惑。

members.speakLineEn: After a sleepless night, his dull answers showed he was barely awake.
members.speakLineZh: 一夜未睡後，他遲鈍的回答顯示幾乎醒不過來。

members.speakLineEn: A fatuous claim that grades do not matter annoyed serious students.
members.speakLineZh: 說成績無關緊要的愚笨說法，惹惱了認真的學生。

members.speakLineEn: His inept handling of the press conference created needless panic.
members.speakLineZh: 他不適當地處理記者會，造成不必要的恐慌。

related.synonyms: awkward, clumsy, cumbersome, inapt, ill-chosen, feckless

members.speakLineEn: The carpenter tapped the peg gently with a wooden mallet.
members.speakLineZh: 木匠用木槌輕輕敲打木栓。

members.speakLineEn: She cleaned the camera lens before photographing the garden flowers.
members.speakLineZh: 拍攝花園花朵前，她先擦拭相機鏡頭。

members.speakLineEn: Turn the ring slowly until the text comes into sharp focus.
members.speakLineZh: 慢慢轉動對焦環，直到文字清晰對焦。

members.speakLineEn: Quick wit saved the speaker when the projector suddenly failed.
members.speakLineZh: 投影機突然故障時，機智救了演講者一命。

members.speakLineEn: After three all-nighters, fogbrain made him forget simple passwords.
members.speakLineZh: 連續三晚熬夜後，霧腦讓他連簡單密碼都忘了。

members.speakLineEn: The knife's sharp edge sliced the apple into clean, even wedges.
members.speakLineZh: 刀刃鋒利，把蘋果切成整齊均勻的瓣。

members.speakLineEn: A bluntedge knife smashed the tomato instead of cutting it cleanly.
members.speakLineZh: 鈍刃刀子把番茄壓爛，無法乾淨切開。

pitfalls: acumen＝洞察力；別跟 accumulator 扯上
